name: Nha Trang Cathedral
kicker: The stone cathedral on Thái Nguyên
summary: Stone cathedral on Thái Nguyên: see the clock tower and the arches in daylight for the centre’s church. The address is 31A Thái Nguyên in Phước Tân. Information hours run 05:00–17:00, with Sunday Mass also at 18:30. Work started on 3 September 1928. One line dates the opening to 14 March 1933, and the parish contact block says 14 May 1933.
getThere: 31A Thái Nguyên, Phước Tân, in the centre.
heroCaption: The stone clock tower and the arched front of the cathedral
body: Nhà thờ Núi, also the cathedral, stands at 31A Thái Nguyên in Phước Tân. Information hours run 05:00–17:00. Weekday Mass is at 4:45 and 17:00. Sunday Mass is at 5:00, 7:00, 9:30, 16:30, and 18:30. The patronal feast is Christ the King. Ave Maria square, at the foot of the church, opened on 14 September 2011.

Work started on 3 September 1928. One sentence dates the inauguration to 14 March 1933. The contact block dates the founding to 14 May 1933. This is a working church. Come for the square and the stone front in daylight.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Ride inland to Thái Nguyên. The church is the stone tower by Ave Maria square.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station and the church are both in the centre.
